questions.explanation: Geochemistry deals with geochemical mapping used in forestry and environmental monitoring.

options: geochemical mapping used in forestry and environmental monitoring
the abundance of atoms and molecules in the universe
the vital processes occurring in living organisms

questions.prompt: A solution of KClO₃ has a solubility of about 13.2 g per 100 cm³ at 40 °C. If the temperature is decreased, the solubility will ____.
questions.explanation: KClO₃ behaves like most solids: solubility falls when the temperature falls (Exercise 1(ix)).

questions.prompt: Which allotrope of carbon has a cage-like structure?
questions.explanation: Fullerenes have a cage-like structure of pentagons and hexagons.

questions.prompt: Which substance has the formula CaCrO₄?
questions.explanation: CaCrO₄ is the formula of Calcium chromate.

questions.prompt: Which type of mixture has solute particles that cannot be seen and leaves no residue on filter paper?
questions.explanation: A true solution has solute particles that cannot be seen and leaves no residue on filter paper. (Section 1.6)

questions.prompt: Which statement about Potassium chloride (KCl) is correct?
questions.explanation: Potassium chloride (KCl) has a solubility in water that increases with the increase in temperature. (Section 1.8)

options: Potassium chloride (KCl) has a solubility in water that decreases with the increase in temperature.
Potassium chloride (KCl) has a solubility in water that increases with the increase in temperature.

questions.prompt: Which allotropic form is the more stable of the two crystalline allotropic forms of sulphur?
questions.explanation: Rhombic sulphur is the more stable of the two crystalline allotropic forms of sulphur. (Section 1.4)

questions.prompt: Which statement about Buckminster fullerene (C₆₀) is correct?
questions.explanation: Buckminster fullerene (C₆₀) has molecules that are not charged, have no boundaries and have no unpaired electrons. (Section 1.4)

options: Buckminster fullerene (C₆₀) has molecules that are not charged, have no boundaries and have no unpaired electrons.
Buckminster fullerene (C₆₀) has a giant macromolecular structure.
Buckminster fullerene (C₆₀) is the more stable of the two crystalline allotropic forms of sulphur.

questions.prompt: Which statement about a heterogeneous mixture is correct?
questions.explanation: A heterogeneous mixture has different concentrations of its constituents in different parts, for example a sample of rock. (Section 1.5)

options: A heterogeneous mixture has properties that are always different from those of the elements it is formed from.
A heterogeneous mixture has different concentrations of its constituents in different parts, for example a sample of rock.
A heterogeneous mixture is a pure substance made up of two or more different elements combined in a fixed ratio.

questions.prompt: How does the solubility of Silver nitrate in water change as the temperature rises?
questions.explanation: The solubility of Silver nitrate in water increases with temperature.

questions.prompt: Which form of matter is a partially ionized gas containing electrons, ions and photons?
questions.explanation: Plasma is a partially ionized gas containing electrons, ions and photons. (Section 1.2)

questions.prompt: Which branch of chemistry deals with the causes and solutions of pollution?
questions.explanation: Environmental chemistry deals with the causes and solutions of pollution.

questions.prompt: Which of the following is a heterogeneous mixture?
questions.explanation: Concrete is a heterogeneous mixture; solutions are homogeneous (Exercise 1(vi)).

options: A solution of calcium hydroxide in water
A solution of potassium nitrate in water

questions.prompt: Which statement about a solid is correct?
questions.explanation: A solid is relatively incompressible and rigid. (Section 1.2)

options: A solid is relatively incompressible and rigid.
A solid has molecules that are very widely apart with no order whatsoever.

questions.prompt: What does 'structure of matter' mean?
questions.explanation: Structure of matter means the arrangement of atoms in matter.

options: The arrangement of atoms in matter
The percentage of elements in matter

questions.prompt: Which substance has the formula C₆₀?
questions.explanation: C₆₀ is the formula of Buckminster fullerene.
